images.prompt: Landscape 3:2 natural editorial photo based strictly on the attached real product front photo. Recreate the exact pale lilac Himawari No.1208 backpack (29 cm wide x 40 cm tall x 17 cm deep) upright on a seated person's charcoal-clothed lap in a reading area. The backpack is taken off and placed with its front facing the camera. The black backpack shoulder straps are loose behind the bag and below or just above the paired lilac handles. Absolutely no backpack strap is worn by the person, their plain oatmeal sweater is uninterrupted at both shoulders. One hand keeps the top paired carry handles steady and the other hand rests on their own knee. Crop head out, show the whole bag. Preserve center black label, four black rivets, black handle keeper, both opposed curved black zipper tracks and upper pulls exactly like source, and lavender side pockets with black strap segments. No change to body proportions or hardware; do not open zippers or invent pockets. Soft daylight and no writing except authentic logo.
images.review: Direct comparison with No.1208 light-purple product source: pale lilac body, rectangular black wordmark, four rivets, black handle keeper, opposed closed curved zipper tracks and pull positions, side pockets and black back straps are visible. Straps sit behind bag without wrapping the person. Exterior 29 × 40 × 17 cm informed plausible lap scale.

Reproduce reflective silver nylon, black front Himawari wordmark on large flat slip pocket, top short ruched silver carry handle, original compact gathered mouth with black braided drawcord at front center, original oblong silver quilted accessory on front viewer-right with black perimeter zipper, silver straps with black borders and base trim and two base buckles exactly as pictured. Keep shape and width-to-height as source. Neutral background and diffused light. No new hardware, zips, logo, model, extra items, text or open interior.
images.review: Direct comparison with the No.0515 silver wearing source: silver reflective exterior, ruched handle, black wordmark and slip pocket, hanging quilted pouch, gathered upper opening and front loop, silver shoulder straps with dark edges, black base and two buckles all in corresponding positions. Focus on outer rim and central cord rather than interior.
